mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP450 enzymes and increases renal clearance, potentially reducing foscarnet concentrations, while foscarnet may increase phenobarbital levels through protein binding displacement and renal competition.
action: Monitor foscarnet efficacy and phenobarbital levels closely; consider alternative anticonvulsant or adjust dosing based on therapeutic drug monitoring; assess renal function regularly as both drugs are nephrotoxic.
